definitions.explanation: The time of day around noon when people typically eat lunch. Roughly 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}どき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
{昼|ひる}どき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧だった。
examples.english: The restaurant was fully booked at lunchtime.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}どき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{行|い}けば→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{並|なら}ばなくて→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: If you go outside of the lunch rush, you won't have to wait in line.

notes:
Refers specifically to the period around noon associated with the lunch meal. The suffix どき means "time for" and creates a natural, colloquial feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼|ひる}どき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧: lunchtime crowds
- {昼|ひる}どき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid the lunch rush
- {昼|ひる}どき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go at lunchtime

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧: lunch (formal)
- ⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧: lunch (casual)
- {夕|ゆう}どき: around evening/dusk — uses the same どき pattern
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧どき: the right time to eat something

USAGE:
Most commonly used when talking about restaurant crowding, meal timing, or scheduling around the midday period.
